title: Entropy-balanced domain packs for quantization calibration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a reproducible curation and sampling pipeline that produces per-domain calibration packs optimized for FP8 and INT8 quantization validation. The goal is to balance overall informational content (measured via token-level entropy and model confidence distribution) while preserving rare edge-case prompts and per-tenant signal. Packs should be small enough for fast local validation (~5k-20k samples/domain) but representative of production distribution for accuracy regression detection.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline produces per-domain packs with configurable target sizes and preservation rules
Entropy-balanced sampling produces packs where token-entropy distribution matches live traffic within 5% KL divergence per domain
Edge-case quota ensures >=95% coverage of rare intent buckets identified by existing taxonomy
Calibration packs validate FP8 and INT8 quant profiles with accuracy regressions detectable at >=0.5% absolute delta on key metrics
Artifacts (pack manifests, seed lists, sampling config) are stored in Drive and linked from the ticket
implementation_plan: Define domain buckets and rarity taxonomy (product categories, intent clusters, tenant-tier)
Instrument entropy and model-confidence scorers over a 30-day traffic window
Implement stratified sampler: strata = {entropy-quantile, context-length, tenant-tier, intent-bucket}
Add edge-case preservation step that enforces hard quotas for rare strata
Build a reproducible manifest format and reproducible RNG seed handling
Run pilot on 5 domains and evaluate FP8/INT8 validation regressions with runtime-1.22
sampling_strategy: Entropy-balanced stratified sampling: compute per-prompt token entropy using baseline unquantized model logits; split into entropy quantiles (low/med/high). Within each entropy quantile stratify on context length and tenant tier, then sample proportionally to live traffic weights with minimum floor per rare intent. Apply time decay weighting (λ=0.8 over 30 days) to favor recent patterns while keeping historical edge cases. Final packs include a reserved 10% slot for artificially augmented corner-case examples (synthetic paraphrases and prompt truncations) to stress quantization edge behavior.
validation_plan: Run FP8 and INT8 calibration workflows using existing quant harness (experiment ids below)
Compute per-domain metrics: exact-match rate, semantic-similarity delta (embedding cosine), perplexity delta, token-error-rate
Use k-fold holdout (k=5) to estimate variance and ensure pack stability
Define alert thresholds: per-domain semantic-similarity drop >0.8% or perplexity increase >1.5% triggers investigation
Produce a short QC report per run and attach to the rollout dashboard
experiments: EXP-QUANT-2025-013: FP8-profile-v2 on runtime-1.22 (pilot domains) - dataset ~12k/domain
EXP-QUANT-2025-014: INT8-symmetric vs asymmetric on runtime-1.22 - dataset ~8k/domain
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: overfitting packs to entropy metric could underrepresent semantic diversity. Mitigation: enforce intent-bucket floor and use embedding-cluster checks.
Risk: synthetic augmentation introduces distribution shift. Mitigation: keep augmented proportion <=10% and flag results separately in reports.
Risk: per-tenant privacy concerns with curated samples. Mitigation: apply PII redaction and tenant opt-out list; coordinate with Legal for private deployments.
Risk: downstream validation sensitivity differs by model family. Mitigation: run validation across representative model variants and include model-tag in manifest
